import requests

def get_channels():
    # Replace with your Slack API token
    token = "YOUR_API_TOKEN"
    url = f"https://slack.com/api/conversations.list?token={token}"
    response = requests.get(url)
    data = response.json()
    channels = data["channels"]
    return channels

def read_channel_messages(channel):
    # Replace with your Slack API token
    token = "YOUR_API_TOKEN"
    url = f"https://slack.com/api/conversations.history?token={token}&channel={channel}"
    response = requests.get(url)
    data = response.json()
    messages = data["messages"]
    return len(messages)

def get_users_in_channel(channel):
    # Replace with your Slack API token
    token = "YOUR_API_TOKEN"
    url = f"https://slack.com/api/conversations.members?token={token}&channel={channel}"
    response = requests.get(url)
    data = response.json()
    users = data["members"]
    return users

def add_user_to_channel(user, channel):
    # Replace with your Slack API token
    token = "YOUR_API_TOKEN"
    url = f"https://slack.com/api/conversations.invite?token={token}&channel={channel}&users={user}"
    response = requests.post(url)
    return response.json()

def main():
    channels = get_channels()
    min_messages = float('inf')
    min_channel = None
    for channel in channels:
        messages = read_channel_messages(channel["id"])
        if messages < min_messages:
            min_messages = messages
            min_channel = channel["id"]

    users_in_channel = get_users_in_channel(min_channel)
    all_users = requests.get(f"https://slack.com/api/users.list?token=YOUR_API_TOKEN").json()["members"]
    all_user_ids = [user["id"] for user in all_users]

    for user_id in all_user_ids:
        if user_id not in users_in_channel:
            add_user_to_channel(user_id, min_channel)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
